description: Principal can open a PowerShell Remoting (WinRM) session to the target.

telemetry.detail: PowerShell script block logging captures executed code if enabled.
WinRM leaves no disk artifact and blends with admin activity, but script-block logging (4104) exposes payload content where enabled.

prerequisite_privilege: Remote Management Users / admin on target
notes: Good default lateral method. Real exposure hinges on whether ScriptBlock logging (4104) is on and shipped.
